text:
The current core cannot have enough headroom, which explains both the 294 ppm/°C TC and the 0.27 V/V line regulation. The supply stack is Vsd(M3) + Vgs(M1) + Veb. The NMOS level-shift pair has its body tied to vss, so with Vsb ≈ 0.78 V its Vth rises to about 0.71 V. Over temperature:

- **27 °C:** M3 has only 0.13 V of Vds above Vdsat.
- **−40 °C:** Veb rises to about 0.86 V and Vgs to about 0.85 V. M3 drops into triode, which corrupts the PTAT current.
- **Low VDD:** M3 also falls into triode, giving the large line regulation.

The fix is to tie each pair device's body to its own source, which in SKY130 means a deep-nwell isolated p-well. That removes the body effect and frees about 0.25 V for M3. I also lengthen the PMOS mirror for line regulation and correct the line-regulation model so it predicts in V/V.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "M3 lacks headroom (Veb+Vgs_n with body effect) -> triode at cold/low VDD, causing large TC and line reg. Tie NMOS pair bulks to sources (deep nwell), longer PMOS L, fixed line-reg model in V/V."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (4e-6, 1e-6, 10e-6),     # per-branch PTAT current
    "K":      (9.6, 7.5, 12.0),        # R2/R1
    "gmid_p": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),       # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Lp":     (12.0, 4.0, 20.0),       # long L for low lambda -> line regulation
    "gmid_n": (20.0, 12.0, 24.0),      # NMOS level-shift pair (weak inversion, low Vgs)
    "Ln":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "If":     (1.5e-6, 0.5e-6, 5e-6),  # follower bias current
    "Cc":     (1e-12, 0.2e-12, 5e-12), # X-node compensation cap to vdd
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    N = 8
    I = p["I"]; K = p["K"]
    R1 = UT * math.log(N) / I
    R2 = K * R1

    veb1 = 0.735 + UT * math.log(I / 10e-6)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.5)
    vg = VDD - mp.vgs
    # NMOS pair with bulk tied to source (isolated p-well / deep nwell): no body effect
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.5, vsb=0.0)
    vgn = veb1 + mn.vgs
    mf = lut.size("n", 18.0, 1.0, p["If"], vds=VDD - vg, vsb=vg)
    Rf = vg / p["If"]
    vx = vg + mf.vgs

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    n.dev("M3", "ngate", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "ngate", "ngate", "ea", "ea", mn)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "ngate", "sb", "sb", mn)
    n.R("R1", "sb", "eb", R1)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "ea", m=1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "eb", m=N)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    n.dev("MF", "vdd", "x", "vg", "vss", mf)
    n.R("RF", "vg", "vss", Rf)
    n.C("CC", "x", "vdd", p["Cc"])
    # Start-up
    n.M("MSP", "st", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MSN", "st", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MS1", "vg", "st", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 0.5)

    # Predictions
    ptat = K * UT * math.log(N)
    vref = veb1 + ptat
    dveb = (veb1 - 1.2) / 300.0 - 0.25e-3
    dptat = ptat / 300.15
    resid = abs(dveb + dptat)
    curv = 2.5e-3
    tc = (resid * 165 + curv) / vref / 165 * 1e6
    lam = mp.gds / mp.Id                       # 1/V
    # M5 output current error + M3/M4 Vds mismatch -> Vgs offset amplified by K
    line = lam * (ptat + K / p["gmid_n"])      # V/V
    itot = 3 * I + p["If"] + 0.6e-6
    power = VDD * itot
    m3_vds = VDD - vgn
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": line, "power": power,
               "startup_ok": 1, "psrr_1k": -db(line + 1e-4),
               "vx": vx, "vg": vg, "vgn": vgn, "m3_vds": m3_vds, "m2_vds": vx - veb1}
```
